title: PostgresqlClusterV2
description: Definition of a managed Postgresql cluster that can be provisioned in Instaclustr.

pciComplianceMode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

postgresqlVersion.description:
Version of Postgresql to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `18.6.0`
  • `17.11.0`

backupRetentionDays.description: Number of days for which backups are retained, to a maximum of 36. Retention can be changed to between 7 and 36 days, and only on AWS_VPC clusters.

defaultUserPassword.description: Password of the default user created for the PostgreSQL cluster.

synchronousModeStrict.description: Create the PostgreSQL cluster with the selected replication mode, see [PostgreSQL replication mode](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/postgresql/options/replication-mode/).

privateNetworkCluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

resizeSettings.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

alias.description: The alias for the private link service

useAzurePrivateLink.description: Flag to indicate that Azure Private Link is to be used for this cluster data Centre

AzurePrivateLinkSettingsV2.description: Settings required for Azure Private Link to be enabled on a cluster.

cidr.description: Network CIDR in notation, for example 10.0.0.0/16.

primary.description: True when this entry is the data centre primary network.

status.description: Provisioning status of the network registration.

CdcNetworkDetailsV2.description: A network CIDR associated with the data centre (primary or expanded secondary).

CloudProviderEnumV2.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

CurrentClusterOperationStatusV2.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

FsxFileSystemMappingV2.description: A mapping of a rack name to an FSx File System ID for BYO FSx provisioning.

nodeRoles.description: The roles or purposes of the node. Useful for filtering for nodes that have a specific role.

rack.description: Rack name in which the node is located.

privateAddress.description: Private IP address of the node.

deletionTime.description: Deletion time of the node as a UTC timestamp

publicAddress.description: Public IP address of the node.

startTime.description: Start time of the node as a UTC timestamp

pgBouncerVersion.description:
Version of Pg Bouncer to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `1.26.0`

PgBouncerPoolModeEnumV2.description: Creates PgBouncer with the selected mode, see [PgBouncer pool modes] (https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/postgresql-add-ons/using-pgbouncer/)

endpointServiceName.description: The endpoint service name for the private link

useAwsPrivateLink.description: Create a PrivateLink enabled cluster, see [PrivateLink](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/privatelink/).

PostgresqlAwsPrivateLinkSettingsV2.description: Settings required for AWS Private Link to be enabled on a cluster.

deletedNodes.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

loadBalancerEndpoint.description: DNS name of the Network Load Balancer if a load balancer is enabled for the cluster.

numberOfNodes.description: Total number of nodes in the Data Centre.

networks.description: All network CIDR blocks for this data centre, including the primary network and any expanded secondary CIDRs.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

zeroInboundAccess.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

nodeSize.description:

id.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.
awsSettings.x-insta-comment: See x-insta-comment on awsSettings in AllProviderSpecificSettingsV2

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

customSubjectAlternativeNames.description: List of Subject Alternative Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.

nodes.description: List of non-deleted nodes in the data centre

privateConnectivity.description: Create a Private Connectivity enabled cluster

azureSettings.description: Azure specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or GCP settings.

name.description: A logical name for the data centre within a cluster. These names must be unique in the cluster.

region.description: Region of the Data Centre. See the description for node size for a compatible Data Centre for a given node size.

providerAccountName.description: For customers running in their own account. Your provider account can be found on the Create Cluster page on the Instaclustr Console, or the "Provider Account" property on any existing cluster. For customers provisioning on Instaclustr's cloud provider accounts, this property may be omitted.

isPrimaryDataCentre.description: Is this Data centre considered to be the primary (only required if multiple data centres defined).

PostgresqlInterDataCentreReplicationDeta.description: Defines data replication configuration within a Data centre

PostgresqlIntraDataCentreReplicationDeta.description: Defines data replication configuration within a Data centre

PostgresqlPrivateConnectivitySettingsV2.description: Settings required for Private Connectivity to be enabled on a cluster.

ebsEncryptionKey.description: ID of a KMS encryption key to encrypt data on nodes. KMS encryption key must be set in Cluster Resources through the Instaclustr Console before provisioning an encrypted Data Centre.

addSecondaryCidrToVpc.description: When true and a custom VPC is specified, the Data Centre's network will be associated as a secondary CIDR block to the VPC. The association will be removed when the Data Centre is deleted. Only valid when customVirtualNetworkId is set and fsxFileSystemMappings are provided for BYO FSx provisioning. Only applicable for PostgreSQL clusters.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: VPC ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified VPC.

storageNetwork.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use AWS FSx ONTAP: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

fsxFileSystemMappings.description: Mapping of rack names to FSx File System IDs for BYO FSx provisioning. Only applicable for PostgreSQL clusters.

PostgresqlReplicationModeEnumV2.description: Create the PostgreSQL cluster with the selected replication mode, see [PostgreSQL replication mode] (https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/postgresql/options/replication-mode/).

resourceGroup.description: The name of the Azure Resource Group into which the Data Centre will be provisioned.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: VNet ID into which the Data Centre will be provisioned. The VNet must have an available address space for the Data Centre's network allocation to be appended to the VNet. Currently supported for PostgreSQL clusters only.

storageNetwork.description: The private network address block to be used for the storage network. This is only used for certain node sizes, currently limited to those which use Azure NetApp Files: for all other node sizes, this field should not be provided. The network must have a prefix length between /16 and /28, and must be part of a private address range.

customVirtualNetworkId.description: Network name or a relative Network or Subnetwork URI. The Data Centre's network allocation must match the IPv4 CIDR block of the specified subnet. Examples: - Network URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Network name: {network-name}, equivalent to projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/global/networks/{network-name}. - Same-project subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}. - Shared VPC subnetwork URI: projects/{riyoa-gcp-host-project-name}/regions/{region-id}/subnetworks/{subnetwork-name}.

ProviderTagV2.description: Custom tag for cloud provider resources.

notifySupportContacts.description: Setting this property to `true` will notify the Instaclustr Account's designated support contacts on resize completion.

downsizeAcknowledged.description: Set to `true` when the user has acknowledged that this resize reduces resource capacity and may cause node instability.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent nodes to resize during a resize operation.

ResizeSettingsV2.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

SlaTierV2.description: SLA Tier of the cluster. Non-production clusters may receive lower priority support and reduced SLAs. Production tier is not available when using Developer class nodes. See [SLA Tier](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/sla-tier/) for more information.

confirmationPhoneNumber.description: The phone number which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be delete.

confirmationEmail.description: The email address which will be contacted when the cluster is requested to be deleted.
